notes:
Ports: 1433/tcp (MSSQL), 1434/tcp (DAC)
System DBs: master, model, msdb, tempdb, resource
Named pipe: \\<host>\pipe\sql\query
Dangerous: unencrypted client connections, self-signed certs, named pipes enabled, weak/default sa creds

recommended.note: Run NSE and mssqlclient.py against port 1433

name: Reference - MSSQL Ports, Defaults & Dangerous Settings
